topic.title: Number Guessing Game Explained
topic.description: A heavily commented number guessing implementation that explains variable scope, function definitions, and global variables in detail.

learningNotes.whatILearned: How global and local scope interact, when to use the global keyword, and how returning values from functions avoids global state.
learningNotes.challenges: Keeping track of which variables are accessible where.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Refactor to remove global variables entirely using function parameters and returns.
